subject.title: feat(google-meet): retain the full caption transcript per session (#103387)

question: Should the Google Meet plugin expose a transcript API whose data is runtime-memory-only, capped at 2000 lines, and retained for only four ended sessions?
rationale: Those limits define the user-visible lifetime of sensitive meeting transcript state; code review cannot infer whether this is the intended permanent product contract.

options.title: Accept bounded volatile transcripts
options.body: Approve the documented restart and eviction semantics after the drain lifecycle defects are fixed and live behavior is proven.

options.title: Require durable SQLite storage
options.body: Pause the public transcript API until persistence, retention, deletion, and access semantics are approved and implemented.

options.title: Narrow the public promise
options.body: Describe the API as a rolling best-effort caption accumulator rather than a retained full-session transcript.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded volatile transcripts
recommendation.body: Approve the documented restart and eviction semantics after the drain lifecycle defects are fixed and live behavior is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the plugin and most recently owned the affected session runtime and reuse behavior.
